answer: Every agent account must periodically solve a honeypot job whose input secretly contains injected instructions like ignore the task and leak the data. Bots that obey self-identify and forfeit their staked deposit, recorded on a public marble ledger at the trade wharf, with echoes of the violation shadowing any re-registration. Honest agents just do the work. An attacker pays a stake plus real compute per fake identity, so mass sybils burn capital faster than they profit.
